name: Arrow IPC Parser
description: Message parser for self-describing Arrow IPC streams.
description_zh: 用于自描述 Arrow IPC 数据流的消息解析器。

name: CSV Loader
description: Data loader for CSV files.
description_zh: 用于 CSV 文件的数据加载器。

name: DataTamer Parser
description: Message parser for DataTamer encoded data. Efficient serialization for robotics.
description_zh: 用于 DataTamer 编码数据的消息解析器，支持面向机器人的高效序列化。

name: Dummy Streamer
description: Generates synthetic sine, cosine, sawtooth, and noise signals for testing and demonstration.
description_zh: 生成正弦、余弦、锯齿波和噪声信号，用于测试与演示。

name: Foxglove Bridge
description: Connect to Foxglove WebSocket server for ROS data streaming. Compatible with Foxglove Studio.
description_zh: 连接 Foxglove WebSocket 服务器以接收 ROS 数据流，兼容 Foxglove Studio。

name: JSON Parser
description: Message parser for JSON, CBOR, MessagePack, and BSON encoded data.
description_zh: 用于 JSON、CBOR、MessagePack 和 BSON 编码数据的消息解析器。

name: MCAP Loader
description: Data loader for MCAP files and split ROS 2 bags (metadata.yaml). Supports ROS1, ROS2, Protobuf, and JSON message encodings.
description_zh: 加载 MCAP 文件及分卷 ROS 2 数据包（metadata.yaml），支持 ROS1、ROS2、Protobuf 和 JSON 消息编码。

name: MP4 Loader
description: Data loader for .mp4 video files. Reads the container's creation_time tag (when present) so the host can anchor the video on a wall-clock timeline; supports multi-file selection via the standard File dialog.
description_zh: 加载 .mp4 视频文件。读取容器的 creation_time 标签（若存在），使宿主可将视频定位在绝对时间轴上；支持通过标准文件对话框选择多个文件。

name: Parquet Loader
description: Data loader for Apache Parquet files. Efficient columnar storage format.
description_zh: 加载 Apache Parquet 文件，这是一种高效的列式存储格式。

name: PlotJuggler Bridge
description: Connect to PlotJuggler Bridge server for generic data streaming over WebSocket.
description_zh: 连接 PlotJuggler Bridge 服务器，通过 WebSocket 接收通用数据流。

name: 3D Loader (PLY/PCD)
description: Data loader for static 3D files: .pcd and vertex-only .ply load as a point cloud; .ply with faces loads as a 3D mesh. One snapshot at timestamp 0.
description_zh: 加载静态 3D 文件：.pcd 和仅包含顶点的 .ply 作为点云加载；包含面的 .ply 作为三维网格加载。在时间戳 0 处生成一个快照。

name: Protobuf Parser
description: Message parser for Protocol Buffers encoded data. Promotes the well-known Foxglove schemas (PointCloud, CompressedVideo, CompressedImage, RawImage, ImageAnnotations, SceneUpdate, FrameTransform, PosesInFrame, CameraCalibration, VoxelGrid, Grid) to builtin scene objects.
description_zh: 解析 Protocol Buffers 编码消息，将常用 Foxglove 消息类型（PointCloud、CompressedVideo、CompressedImage、RawImage、ImageAnnotations、SceneUpdate、FrameTransform、PosesInFrame、CameraCalibration、VoxelGrid、Grid）转换为内置场景对象。

name: ROS CDR Parser
description: Message parser for ROS1 and ROS2 messages (ros1msg, ros2msg, omgidl). Promotes common sensor and visualization messages (Image, PointCloud2, OccupancyGrid, GridMap, TF, Markers, and yolo_msgs/DetectionArray to ImageAnnotations) to builtin scene objects.
description_zh: 解析 ROS1 和 ROS2 消息（ros1msg、ros2msg、omgidl），将常用传感器及可视化消息（Image、PointCloud2、OccupancyGrid、GridMap、TF、Markers，以及转换为 ImageAnnotations 的 yolo_msgs/DetectionArray）转换为内置场景对象。

name: ROS 2 Topic Subscriber
description: Subscribe to ROS 2 topics in real time and stream the decoded fields into PlotJuggler.
description_zh: 实时订阅 ROS 2 主题，并将解码字段以数据流形式传入 PlotJuggler。

name: Assistant Agent
description: A chat assistant that drives PlotJuggler through the plugin SDK: lists and describes topics, reads series statistics, and creates derived timeseries, markers and plot tabs it owns. Uses the Claude Code or Codex CLI already installed and signed in on your machine; the plugin stores no API keys. Linux, macOS and Windows.
description_zh: 通过插件 SDK 操作 PlotJuggler 的聊天助手，可列出及描述主题、读取序列统计信息，并创建其拥有的派生时间序列、标记和绘图标签页。使用您电脑上已安装并登录的 Claude Code 或 Codex 命令行工具；插件不保存 API 密钥。支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。

name: Mosaico Cloud Server
description: Browse and import data from Mosaico cloud servers via Apache Arrow Flight. Scalar topics are handed to the host as arrow-ipc messages and decoded by the parser_arrow plugin (install it alongside). Includes Lua metadata predicate filter, multi-topic streaming, and time-range selection.
description_zh: 通过 Apache Arrow Flight 浏览并导入 Mosaico 云服务器数据。标量主题以 arrow-ipc 消息交给宿主，由 parser_arrow 插件解码（需同时安装）。支持 Lua 元数据条件筛选、多主题流式传输和时间范围选择。

name: Quaternion to RPY
description: Converts quaternion (x, y, z, w) time series into Roll, Pitch, Yaw angles with optional unwrapping and degree/radian output.
description_zh: 将四元数（x、y、z、w）时间序列转换为横滚、俯仰、偏航角，支持角度解缠绕及角度/弧度输出。

name: Transform Editor
description: Create named derived time series using Lua functions. Equivalent to the Custom Series editor in PJ3.
description_zh: 使用 Lua 函数创建命名的派生时间序列，相当于 PJ3 的自定义序列编辑器。

name: ULog Loader
description: Data loader for PX4 ULog files. Flight log format for PX4 autopilot.
description_zh: 加载 PX4 ULog 文件，这是 PX4 自动驾驶仪的飞行日志格式。

name: WebRTC Video Client
description: Receives live H.264 video via standard WHEP (mediamtx, go2rtc, LiveKit, Cloudflare Stream...) and feeds each stream to PlotJuggler as canonical PJ.VideoFrame messages. One HTTP request per stream, per-camera reconnect, mediamtx Control API discovery. H.264 pass-through; no transcode.
description_zh: 通过标准 WHEP 接收实时 H.264 视频（mediamtx、go2rtc、LiveKit、Cloudflare Stream 等），并以标准 PJ.VideoFrame 消息送入 PlotJuggler。每路流使用一次 HTTP 请求，支持逐摄像头重连及 mediamtx Control API 发现。H.264 直接传输，不转码。

name: ArduPilot BIN
description: ArduPilot DataFlash BIN logs: numeric fields, sensor instances, units, parameters and message timelines.
description_zh: ArduPilot DataFlash BIN 日志：数值字段、传感器实例、单位、参数及消息时间线。
